name: SDR / Radio
description: Hardware-gated 433.92 MHz sensor snapshots plus installed SDR, AIS, and radio-control utilities.
help_text: RTL-433 and AIS expose hardware-gated reviewed tuner selection. AIS maps the exact rtl_ais dual-frequency/sample/output/gain/PPM options, logs decoded NMEA locally, creates an authenticated artifact, and uses the shared tuner lock and bounded lifecycle.
